questions.question: In his letter to the Corinthians, Paul said no one can say "Jesus is Lord" without whose help?
Paul wrote to the Corinthians about many different spiritual gifts. How does each believer end up with their gift?

answers.text: The Spirit gives as He determines
Each person picks the one they want
The church leaders hand them out

questions.question: Paul told the Corinthians that Jews and Greeks, slave and free, were all baptized by one Spirit into one body. True or false?
In Paul's picture of the church as a body, who decided where each part of the body belongs?

answers.text: Each part by its own choice
The strongest part of the body
